body: N-39 DRAWN 17 Nov 2026, REVISED in the fix round of PR #114 (design PR, docs only; nothing built, nothing walked; the item stays todo until the build). FRAMES. screens-library-and-browse.html: S-16 "downloaded" stop (three rows now: Stop, a Wi-Fi wait and Retry all above the mini player), stopping, stopped, reopened, reason; S-17 "playlist" stopped; NEW S-96 "dloff" sheet, sheet-stopped, confirm. screens-first-run-and-settings.html: S-95 "dlnote" dl-stopped. STRINGS (English; Arabic is in the frames). Stop / Resume. "Stopping...". "Stopped · 12 of 217 on this phone · 40 ready on your server". Reason: "Interrupted before it finished.". Card: "Prog snob is stopped" / "12 of 217 stay on this phone. Resume continues from there.". Dialog: "Remove Prog snob from this phone?" / "The 12 songs on this phone (340 MB) are deleted, and the rest will not be downloaded." / "Your music stays on your server and you can download it again. A song that another download also has stays on this phone." DECISIONS, all PROPOSED (the lead's D1 to D5 of 17 Nov, taken on the owner's behalf while he is away; the advisor may change them). D2: a Download's Stop leaves ONE result card (PB-43 amended; an import's own Stop still leaves none). D3: on a line that is an import and the Download of its playlist, Stop stops only the phone copy (the import has its own Stop on the import page and goes on): said in the S-16, S-95 and PB-43 words. D5: the system's stamp dates the stopped card, no clock time in its text. Kept from the first drawing: Stop is the phone copy only and the server goes on saving (docs/17 has no route that cancels one download's keeping; COST: a Download of a list that was not an import has no way to stop the server's part); a stopped row keeps its place and section and has no Retry; the sheet has Stop as its own row (today "Stop and remove download" deletes with one tap, PB-40) and Remove always asks; every door that turns a WHOLE download off asks (the sheet, the Settings trash button, Remove all). THE REASON SENTENCE. PR #113 is merged (de8993b): kDownloadStoppedReason = "The download was stopped" (download_manager.dart) is what a cancel by something that is not the manager records (the Cancel of an older build's downloader card, a reset, a kept update; a system stop arrives as failed, never canceled: PB-F22). Today phoneFailureWords turns it into "Could not be saved on this phone."; the build adds one branch that reads the constant and says "Interrupted before it finished." FOR A NATIVE ARABIC READER (Arabic is N-41): the last sentence of the confirm dialog (a song another download also has) was re-worded as “وأي أغنية موجودة في تنزيل آخر تبقى على هذا الهاتف.”; the reason line is unchanged. WHAT THE BUILD MUST DO: store the stop in the phone's database FIRST, then cancel the transfers (so the canceled-as-failed branch of #113 never sees it); start(), every pump, sync and reconnect leave a stopped download's rows alone; Resume sends keep/ask again; a stopped download keeps keep/watch; songs added later are neither asked nor copied until Resume; stopped wins over a wait reason. A migration for the stopped flag, a docs/33 row with test FILES named, a CHANGELOG line. CHECKS. The page's own check=1: 0 issues in all 168 frames of the library file in 8 combinations (light and dark, 100 and 200 percent, ltr and rtl). The other two files have no checker: the same measures injected into the open pages show nothing new in the new frames. A vertical measure (the checker does not see it) in headless Edge at 360x800: at 100 percent every Stop, Resume, Retry, failed-song line, sheet and dialog of the new frames is above the mini player or inside the frame; at 200 percent the lists run on below the mini player as in the older S-16 frames, the confirm dialog's body scrolls by design, and in Arabic the last line of the reason frame touches the mini player. Stop, Resume and Retry are 48 dp targets.
